== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Vehicle Mine (Dark) (PC Errata 2013 slip)]]. Compared with the printed card [[Vehicle Mine (Dark)]]. Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>bd700340e9f10a27f49ca5a68cc9785b0fd9e473</code>.
